entry.definition: Definite article used to identify a specific person, place, thing, group, idea, or clause.
Marker that a following noun phrase is already known, grounded, or uniquely identified in context.
Used to compare one role, state, manner, or identity with another.
Used to mean while, because, or in the way that, depending on sentence structure.
Connected to a concrete source file, observation, rule, or verified context instead of an unreferenced guess.
